# t17: Set Up Invoicing (Xero/Wave) + ABN
## Type: Revenue/Legal | Phase: 1 | Status: 🟡 OPEN
## Auto-generated: Feb 20, 2026

### Context
You need to be able to send a professional invoice within 24 hours of a verbal yes. Don't scramble at the moment a client commits.

### ABN First
- Check if ABN is active: abr.business.gov.au
- If not: register at register.business.gov.au (free, 10 minutes)
- Business structure: Sole Trader is fine for Phase 1
- Business name: "Kamunity" or "Michael Fuller" (sole trader can operate under own name)

### Invoicing Options

**Wave (free):** wave.com — free invoicing, accepts cards (fee on transactions). Good for Phase 1.

**Xero (~$35/month):** Better accounting, BAS/GST reports. Worth it once revenue is consistent.

**Recommendation:** Start with Wave. Switch to Xero at first GST threshold ($75K/year — unlikely in Phase 1).

### First Invoice Template
- Invoice number: KAM-001
- From: [Your name/ABN]
- To: [Client org + ABN if applicable]
- Description: [Service name] — [Date/period]
- Amount: $X + GST (if GST registered) OR $X (if not registered yet)
- Payment terms: 14 days
- Bank details: BSB + Account number
- Thank you note

### Constitutional Check
✅ Principle 8 (Financial Safety) — proper invoicing prevents cash flow problems
✅ GST: not required until $75K annual turnover — confirm current position

### Next Step
Check ABN status (2 min). Sign up for Wave (10 min). Create first invoice template and save it.
Time estimate: 30 minutes total.
